Title: Azure Container Instances now available in Central India and South Central US

Body.Content:
Azure Container Instances supports Linux and Windows containers in two new regions: Central India (Pune) and South Central US (Texas).

Container Instances is now available in 11 regions across the globe. For more information, see the full region availability details.

Azure Container Instances enables customers to run containers on Azure without managing servers or having to learn new tools. 

For more service and feature information, see the product documentation.
